privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collectBody:
Your Pi username and Pi user id, your Pi wallet address, the language you choose, the jobs and responses you create, the photos you upload, the address and map point you enter, and your reviews.
We never ask for your Pi passphrase, and PiFix cannot see it.
privacy.useBody: To show your jobs to masters near you, to match masters with jobs inside their working radius, to process payments and payouts, to compute ratings, and to resolve disputes.
privacy.paymentsBody: Payments run on the Pi Network. PiFix stores the payment identifier, the amount, the memo and the transaction id. Escrow is recorded in our database; the Pi itself moves on the Pi blockchain.
privacy.photosBody: Photos are stored on Cloudinary. Location metadata is stripped on upload. Verification documents (ID and selfie) are stored privately, are visible only to administrators, and are deleted if verification is rejected.
privacy.locationBody: Location is requested only when you tap the location button, and only to compute distances. You can always type the address manually instead. We store the coordinates of your job or your working base, not a movement history.
privacy.retentionBody: Account data is kept while your account exists. Payment and job records are kept for accounting and dispute resolution.
privacy.rightsBody: You can delete your account at any time from your profile. Your username and wallet address are erased and your account is anonymised; completed jobs and ratings remain in the statistics with no link to you.
privacy.cookiesBody: PiFix uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Your session token and language choice are kept in your browser's local storage.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy request, contact the app owner through the Pi Developer Portal listing for PiFix.
privacy.contactWithChannel: For questions about your data — what we hold, or deleting it — write to:
